title: Far-Left Streamer Hasan Piker Says US Commits ‘Pound For Pound’ More Terrorism Than Al Qaeda
body: Left-wing streamer Hasan Piker said in an interview released Thursday that he believes the United States has been responsible for more terrorism than Al Qaeda when measured by the number of people killed, remarks that quickly generated controversy and prompted Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed to publicly disagree with him.
